answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1360 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the timber. The forge index is deterministic from ledger replay, so that nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes an attacker to the back of the ledge queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. Honest users pay that once, farms 14 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
